_說明: 37 個節慶（15 個台灣節日＋22 個節氣）的意涵、場景元素（英文，直接進生圖提示詞）、配色與月相。moon 是當天月相：含月亮的節慶生圖時一律照此寫（AI 常把滿月畫成彎月）；節氣是國曆日期、每年對到的農曆日不同，一律 none，要畫月亮時當年查。可以自行增修；新增節慶要在 scripts/festival_dates.py 補日期規則，否則排程算不到它。可選欄位：costume（主角換造型用，對應 character.json 的 figure 樣式）、tone（整體語氣，例如莊重的節日）。

春節.meaning: 辭舊迎新、闔家團圓、新年好運
春節.motifs: red lanterns, spring couplet shapes without writing, tangerines, firecracker-shaped paper decorations, plum blossoms

除夕.meaning: 圍爐團圓、守歲、感謝這一年
除夕.motifs: round family dinner table with hot pot, warm indoor lamps, red envelopes without writing

元宵.meaning: 賞燈、猜燈謎、吃湯圓、團圓
元宵.motifs: glowing paper lanterns without writing, sweet rice dumplings (tangyuan) in a bowl, full moon
元宵.palette: orange glow, night indigo, warm gold

清明.meaning: 慎終追遠、踏青、春日思念
清明.motifs: fresh green hills, willow branches, spring rain, kites, wild flowers
清明.palette: fresh green, misty white, soft sky blue

端午.meaning: 划龍舟、吃粽子、避邪保平安
端午.motifs: cute dragon boat on a river, zongzi rice dumplings, mugwort bundles, fragrant sachets
端午.palette: river blue, leaf green, warm yellow

七夕.meaning: 牛郎織女相會、珍惜身邊的人
七夕.motifs: starry night sky, milky way, a bridge of magpies, soft glowing stars
七夕.palette: night violet, starlight silver, soft pink

中元.meaning: 普渡祈福、敬天地、心存善念
中元.motifs: floating river lanterns, incense smoke curls, offering fruits, calm water

中元.tone: solemn and gentle, NOT playful, no party mood

中秋.meaning: 月圓人團圓、賞月、烤肉、吃月餅與柚子

母親節.motifs: carnations, gift box, heart shapes, cozy home

父親節.motifs: warm porch light, a cup of tea, necktie-shaped gift, evening home
